args.script: (function(){var m=(document.body.innerText||'').match(/"access_token":"([^"]+)"/);if(!m){throw new Error('取 access_token 失败（40164=出口 IP 不在公众号白名单）: '+(document.body.innerText||'').slice(0,200));}return m[1];})()

(async function(){var P={{payload}};var tk='{{token}}';function fd(b64,name){var b=atob(b64);var u=new Uint8Array(b.length);for(var i=0;i<b.length;i++)u[i]=b.charCodeAt(i);var f=new FormData();f.append('media',new Blob([u],{type:'image/png'}),name);return f;}async function up(f){var r=await fetch('https://api.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/material/add_material?type=image&access_token='+tk,{method:'POST',body:f});var t=await r.text();var j;try{j=JSON.parse(t);}catch(e){throw new Error('add_material 非JSON响应: '+t.slice(0,120));}return j;}var out={media_ids:[],names:[],errors:[]};var list=P.images||[];for(var i=0;i<list.length;i++){var im=list[i];var j=await up(fd(im.b64,im.name||('img'+i+'.png')));if(j.errcode){out.errors.push({index:i,name:im.name||('img'+i+'.png'),errcode:j.errcode,errmsg:j.errmsg||''});}else{out.media_ids.push(j.media_id);out.names.push(im.name||('img'+i+'.png'));}}if(!out.media_ids.length){throw new Error('一张都没传上去: '+JSON.stringify(out.errors[0]||{}));}return out;})()
